scope: Modern primary compact reader first; no reference writer/backfill/DDL/LLM schema/raw/archive activation.

boundaries.models.primary_projections: Exact version1 result/request/schema/raw retained-record canonical hash plus restricted observation map. No LLM schema change.
boundaries.primary_projections: Pure typed resolver. Immutable paid body/input facts; mutable source URL/kind/check/selection/text/law/revision retained separately. Accounting original four values or all4zero actual _reused. Raw field presence/defaults preserved; no body/input regeneration.
boundaries.adapters.primary_projections: Actual indexed consumer owner. Current foreign: known target primary application OR reciprocal persisted link + source primary application. READY separate exact source collection/ready receipt + original result and actual consumer generation; collection never authorizes current. No result history scan.
boundaries.sqlite_repo: Existing row/memo/equal-save readers carry owner; cost validates modern refs before ranking projected accounting. Physical scratch restore checks before touching current DB. Save APIs remain inline.
boundaries.rollover: Existing atomic move count must equal selected snapshots. Corroborated immutable original/source primary receipt records same retained-result target receipt after move before get. Hydrated analysis/generation/editorial must match carried snapshot; failure rolls back all. Unknown/legacy inline behavior retained.
boundaries.doctor: Existing computation doctor counts modern refs; independent physical validator checks exact admitted positions, index/parent identities and frozen encoded snapshots. Unsupported positions fail.
boundaries.json_storage: Existing duplicate-safe/finite JSON parser/canonical serialization moved to neutral shared helpers; legacy public wrappers retain behavior.

controls: Current source/text/law/selection/revision differs lawfully from paid input; immutable body/model/input facts cannot be overridden.
Raw paid record unknown usage/default absence survives digest and public field-set hydration.
Public get/current/ready/memo/cost/dump/restore2; malformed ref doctor and failed restore preserve both DBs.
Actual fake-paid RCL/Wykaz native current projections survive cleanup, two rollovers, quiet repeat and restore without rekeying paid records.
Receipt fault, moved-count mismatch and changed target projection roll back owner move+new receipt.
Same government number without recorded transfer does not authorize foreign ref.
Actual ordinary reciprocal link + source receipt permits current read before target receipt; first foreign apply remains inline.
Native ready work move inline/compact; original collection+alias+exact generation required, missing/stale fails.
producer_barrier: Reader release precedes any runtime references.
First foreign write before known alias/receipt must stay inline; no nullable-ID/same-number inference.
Changed-answer _same_text_read_again and clipped delivery views stay inline unless exactly equal to paid body; no answer patch mechanism.
Frozen requests/batch contexts/delivery/content snapshots stay inline. Only current, ready.record and root primary memo positions admitted.

Selection metadata can still be large; later writer needs explicit cap/savings plus populated SQL/gzip qualification. Parent result/application retention is required; no raw archive decision/backfill.
